scope: Publicly documented metadata, retention, privacy, and measurable usage/operational metrics for OpenAI and Anthropic/Claude
limitation: This is a public-documentation analysis, not access to private backend telemetry, internal databases, undisclosed metrics, private prompts, or proprietary source code.

api_and_business_distinctions: API abuse-monitoring logs may contain prompts/responses and derived metadata such as classifier outputs
OpenAI states that business/API inputs and outputs are not used for training by default
Qualifying API customers can use retention controls including Zero Data Retention
openai.retention_example: OpenAI documentation describes a default 30-day retention period for qualifying API abuse-monitoring logs, subject to documented exceptions and product/configuration differences.

anthropic_claude.commercial_api_retention: Anthropic documents a standard 30-day backend deletion period for commercial API inputs/outputs, subject to contractual arrangements and documented safety/legal exceptions.
anthropic_claude.consumer_retention: Anthropic documents a standard 30-day backend deletion period for consumer Claude conversations, with different retention possible when users opt into model improvement or under safety/legal circumstances.
anthropic_claude.training_retention: Anthropic documents that consumer users who opt into model improvement can have applicable new/resumed conversations and coding sessions retained for up to five years.
anthropic_claude.safety_retention: Anthropic documents that conversations flagged for Usage Policy violations may be retained for up to two years and associated trust-and-safety classifier scores for up to seven years.
anthropic_claude.enterprise_controls: Claude Enterprise supports custom retention controls; Anthropic documentation describes a 30-day minimum for configurable retention.
anthropic_claude.admin_reporting: Anthropic's Admin API documentation describes organization usage reports that can group usage by API key, workspace, model, service tier, and context window and report uncached input, cache creation, cache read, and output token measurements.

analysis_principles: Separate consumer, commercial/API, and enterprise products
Distinguish documented metadata categories from private telemetry
Record exact product/version and documentation date
Do not infer undocumented internal implementation details
Treat retention periods as policy/documentation claims rather than universal guarantees
Preserve source provenance for every metric
status: Public-source OpenAI and Anthropic/Claude metadata and metrics analysis uploaded for comparative research.
